setup.command: set -eu; GCLOUD_ROOT="$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk"; if [ ! -x "$GCLOUD_ROOT/bin/gcloud" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"; curl --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -fsSL https://dl.google.com/dl/cloudsdk/channels/rapid/downloads/google-cloud-cli-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | tar -xz -C "$HOME/.local"; "$GCLOUD_ROOT/install.sh" --quiet --path-update=false --command-completion=false --usage-reporting=false; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; ln -sf "$GCLOUD_ROOT/bin/gcloud" "$HOME/.local/bin/gcloud"; printf '%s\n' 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.profile"; printf '%s\n' 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.local/google-cloud-sdk/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
